reviews.text: Best massage and facial ever!! I've been to Laurel and Meaghan a few times now, and every visit has been great. I always leave feeling so relaxed and refreshed. Definitely recommend!

Marsia and Lindsay were a dream duo to work with!!!! They made my wedding morning feel calm and comfortable from start to finish! All of us were absolutely glowing after they finished! I am so thankful to both of them for their professionalism, attention to detail and calm presence! Highly recommend for any bride!

I loved The Beauty Studio so much. I went in for a spray tan and Marisa worked with me and it came out amazing. She was so kind and helpful and the environment is so lively and welcoming. I recommend The Beauty Studio to anyone in need of their services!
